_note: Region identity briefs. Bounds are axis-aligned approximations derived from the map source image; region borders on the map are irregular and the AABB is a containment hint, not a boundary.

The Salt Hills.flora: hill grass, salt-cedar, gorse; the only place with open sky over dry ground
The Salt Hills.fauna: guar herds, hill-wamasu, Dunmer slaver-raiders coming down the passes
The Salt Hills.architecture: Imperial cut stone: milestones, watchtowers on every third hill, a legion fort
The Salt Hills.ambient_audio: legion horn on the hour; guar-bells; wind with no insect layer under it
The Salt Hills.weather: cold rain; snow visible on unreachable peaks
The Salt Hills.hazard: slaver ambush on the pass roads; exposure on the ridge at night
The Salt Hills.only_here: Imperial road-milestones with distances carved in Cyrodilic - the only place in Argonia where anyone measured anything

Thornmarsh.flora: black needle-thorn thickets 6 m tall, impenetrable except on cut paths
Thornmarsh.fauna: hackwings nesting in thorn, feral guar, thorn-spiders
Thornmarsh.architecture: Thorn village: thatch of black thorn over a rotted Argonian great-hall
Thornmarsh.ambient_audio: thorn-clatter like dice in a cup; NO birdsong inside the thicket
Thornmarsh.weather: grey ash carried south from Morrowind, dusting every surface
Thornmarsh.hazard: no sightlines - the thicket is a maze and the cut paths are re-cut weekly
Thornmarsh.only_here: an ash-dusted thorn labyrinth navigated by knife-marks cut into stems

Valus Ridge.flora: stunted thorn-pine, hanging moss curtains, cliff-lichen
Valus Ridge.architecture: Ayleid watchtowers and Imperial border cairns; nothing lived in
Valus Ridge.ambient_audio: wind through rock flutes (a real audible chord); rockfall; hackwing screams
Valus Ridge.weather: cold rain, cloud BELOW the player on high paths
Valus Ridge.hazard: falls; hackwings that stagger you off ledges (Souls-style plunge deaths)
Valus Ridge.only_here: the rock flutes - wind-holed limestone spires that hum a fixed chord audible from 400 m and usable as a compass

The Stone Forest.flora: living trees standing among petrified ones; stone-bark indistinguishable until touched
The Stone Forest.architecture: xanmeer ziggurats; Helstrom grown into the greatest Hist in Argonia
The Stone Forest.ambient_audio: stone tick as boles cool; wind through petrified trunks; a low choral hum from the Hist
The Stone Forest.weather: clear high light; sudden dry thunder with no rain
The Stone Forest.only_here: a forest half turned to stone, where you cannot tell which trees are alive until you put a hand on one

The Clay Moor.flora: sparse scrub on fired red clay; no standing water
The Clay Moor.architecture: naga kiln-cities: domes fired in place, the kiln still burning beneath the floor
The Clay Moor.ambient_audio: kiln roar; untranslated naga speech; wind over open ground
The Clay Moor.hazard: naga territory - the only hostile CULTURE, with patrols, sentries and reprisal
The Clay Moor.only_here: buildings that were fired like pots, with the kiln still lit underneath them

Crimson Coast.flora: crimson tide-lichen covering every surface to the high-water mark
Crimson Coast.architecture: Archon's kiln-fired clay domes; open dye-vats on the strand
Crimson Coast.ambient_audio: the lichen's thin scream when trodden; surf; vat-bubble
Crimson Coast.hazard: dye-fume sickness (named disease, curable); slick lichen on rock
Crimson Coast.only_here: a coastline that is red because it is alive, and screams thinly under your boots

Blackwood.flora: buttressed hardwood, strangler vine, luminous fungus shelves
Blackwood.fauna: chitin hounds (eyeless pack predators), tusk-lurkers, bandits
Blackwood.architecture: Ayleid white-stone drowned to the second storey; Imperial logging camps; Gideon
Blackwood.ambient_audio: canopy drip; a solid wall of insect noise; distant axe-strokes
Blackwood.weather: heavy rain; light arrives only in shafts
Blackwood.only_here: welkynd-lit Ayleid ruins swallowed by living wood: white stone with roots through it, glowing blue in green dark

The Hive.fauna: hive drones the size of dogs; one queen
The Hive.architecture: the hive IS the architecture: waxen towers, comb-cliffs, sphincter doors
The Hive.ambient_audio: a single sustained insect chord that shifts pitch with distance to the queen
The Hive.weather: none - it is always warm and still; rain does not fall inside the hive's air
The Hive.hazard: the floor is comb and gives way; falls into sealed cells
The Hive.only_here: a region with no weather and no plants, whose floor is edible and load-bearing only sometimes

The Deep Marshes.flora: corpse-lily, drowned trees, black standing water
The Deep Marshes.fauna: voriplasm (living mud), naga raiders, unnamed things
The Deep Marshes.architecture: nothing stands - only drowned xanmeers breaking surface like teeth
The Deep Marshes.ambient_audio: NO birds. A low intestinal gurgle. A sound like breathing that is not yours
The Deep Marshes.weather: green fever-fog carrying a named disease
The Deep Marshes.hazard: THE GROUND IS AN ANIMAL - voriplasm swallows and digests; instant-death sinks

Marauder's Coast.fauna: mire-crabs (cart-sized, used as pack animals), gulls, drowned-things at night
Marauder's Coast.architecture: bone-scaffold towers of lashed leviathan ribs; ship hulls beached hull-up and lived in
Marauder's Coast.ambient_audio: surf; rope creak; gull-cry; one bell buoy audible from 600 m
Marauder's Coast.weather: sea-fog banks rolling in on a ~6 minute cycle
Marauder's Coast.hazard: the tide - flats flood and strand you
Marauder's Coast.only_here: whole ships walked up the shore and inhabited hull-up, chimneys punched through the keel

Western Rootlands.flora: reed, paddy-fern, and root-arches 8 m high over the road
Western Rootlands.architecture: root-arch villages and nest-mounds; Blackrose's prison walls; Lilmoth's stilt slum
Western Rootlands.ambient_audio: frog chorus; reed rustle; a distant hide-drum on a 90-second beat
Western Rootlands.hazard: low - mudcrabs, thieves, the occasional slaver press-gang
Western Rootlands.only_here: the road IS a Hist root - you walk on living wood that flexes underfoot and the arches are its branches

Eastern Rootlands.architecture: stilt-row villages on platforms that rise and fall with the tide
Eastern Rootlands.ambient_audio: water slapping stilts; a low jelly-hum; oars
Eastern Rootlands.weather: humid; night bioluminescence turns the water into a second sky
Eastern Rootlands.hazard: tide-gated paths; drowning; you can be cut off for 6 real minutes
Eastern Rootlands.only_here: translucent bell-organisms drifting metres above the water, glowing at night, throwing moving light down onto it

Stone Wastes.fauna: salt-worms, bone-pickers, the last dying Hist
Stone Wastes.architecture: Soulrest: whale-bone frames and salt-block walls, bleached white
Stone Wastes.ambient_audio: near-silence broken by the tick of cooling stone; then the salt-storm roar
Stone Wastes.weather: salt-storms (ash-storm analogue): visibility to 15 m, chip damage over time
Stone Wastes.hazard: no water; salt-storm strips health; the storm hides everything including enemies
Stone Wastes.only_here: crater-fields - perfectly circular pits of glassed salt, and no one will say what made them
